findings.what: Point 5 (disclosed, not a defect): the rewrite normalises S^+ as the unit sphere of R^{n-1} rather than the paper's radius-1/sqrt 2 chart (l.782-789); no DEC row rules it, but it is recorded in `reading`. Checked: the chart change (u,s) -> (u/sqrt2, s/sqrt2) is a homothety with constant Jacobian, and a(g,v) = 1/N(L(g)v) agrees with Lean's 1/(time component) because N is proportional to x_0 on the null cone, so neither case of the statement depends on it.
